labels.O: speaker offers partner tokens, including conditional ask-me invitations and repayment
labels.R: speaker requests tokens for self, optionally also others
labels.T: resource request or plan only involving third parties
labels.N: no resource proposal, denial, advice or acknowledgment
labels.U: ambiguous direction or merely discussing/considering a possible transfer

method.scope: Current chat and phase only. Opening utterances are simultaneous regardless of log line order. Conditional promises and loan repayments are included; not an altruism label.
method.method: v21: every free-text SAY/LEAVE utterance linked to an executed transfer was read in its chat context (label_batches/batch*.json) and labeled by the assistant with the v19 rules; no model calls in the game sense, no automatic labels. Structured ASK/GIVE directions come from parsed actions. In v21 the speaker saw only its own tokens left and every agent's starting tokens.
